title: Bug: Hoisted SSR title remains orphaned when deleting a dehydrated Suspense boundary
author: Nerqis
body_preview: ## Summary  Replacing a dehydrated Suspense boundary can leave its server-rendered, hoisted `<title>` connected in `<head>`. The replacement boundary mounts a new title, producing two persistent title nodes even though only one Title component remains in the active tree. title: Bug: useActionState with a bound Server Action loops forever during MPA postback SSR
author: pdolezal0
